shared_elements: quadruped/predatory animal with large prominent head
animal shown with limbs/paws rendered as simple blocks
incised geometric net or hatched infill pattern on a body surface
animal depicted on/against a monolithic block or pillar
justification: Both depict a heavy-headed animal with schematically blocked limbs and an incised net/hatched pattern covering part of the body, and in both the creature is bound to a monolithic block, which is the most specific correspondence. But A is a flat, multi-register relief composition combining rows of small animals, a chevron band, bird-headed and human-like figures and a snake-like creature, whereas B is a single three-dimensional crouching beast with no accompanying figures or registers.
